description: Wobble Squabble's join tile: while a game runs a player on it is not taken onto the bridge; buying tickets there (BTCKS) after the game takes them on, and their arrival on the free start tile starts the next game

steps.name: WALK
steps.note: Down the ladder into the water, on to 13,11

messages.name: ALERT
messages.body: Teleport mode is set to: true

steps.name: WALK
steps.note: p on the other start tile 21,15: PT_PREPARE (p is player 0)

steps.name: PTM
steps.note: Move 8 is no move; PT_START 3 s after PT_PREPARE

messages.name: ALERT
messages.body: Teleport mode is set to: true

steps.name: WALK
steps.note: q warps onto the join tile: a game is on, so nothing more happens

steps.name: PTM
steps.note: b falls: PT_WIN, PT_END, the tickets, b in the water; q stays on the join tile

steps.name: BTCKS
steps.note: Two tickets for q, on the join tile: warped onto the bridge, walks to the start tile 21,11, PT_PREPARE against p

steps.name: PTM
steps.note: Move 8 is no move; PT_START 3 s after PT_PREPARE

steps.name: G_STAT
steps.note: Jem joins and the camera is scheduled, so leaving works (see the header)
